description: This file defines the MacroNode class in the Twig templating engine, representing a macro node with methods for construction and compilation, including handling of macro arguments and generating PHP code.

classes.name: MacroNode
classes.description: Represents a macro node in Twig, with functionality for constructing macro definitions and compiling them into PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a MacroNode, handling deprecation warnings for argument types and ensuring proper argument structure.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the macro, including argument handling, context setup, and macro body rendering.
